PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://example.org/ref#>
SELECT ?zone ?temp_tsid ?setpoint_tsid
WHERE {
  ?zone brick:hasSubclass* brick:Zone .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?tp .
  ?tp a brick:Air_Temperature .
  ?tp ref:hasTimeseriesId ?temp_tsid .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?sp .
  ?sp a brick:Coasting_Setpoint .
  ?sp ref:hasTimeseriesId ?setpoint_tsid .
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?c WHERE { ?p a ?c . } LIMIT 200

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?n WHERE { ?z a ?n . FILTER(regex(str(?n),"zone","i")) } LIMIT 50

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?zone ?zone_name ?temp_tsid ?setpoint_tsid
WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone .
  OPTIONAL { ?zone rdfs:label ?zone_name . }
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?tp .
  ?tp a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor .
  ?tp ref:hasTimeseriesId ?temp_tsid .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?sp .
  ?sp a brick:Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint .
  ?sp ref:hasTimeseriesId ?setpoint_tsid .
}
